questions.markdown: A PN-junction germanium diode has a saturation current of $1\,\mu\text{A}$ for an applied forward voltage of $0.2\text{ V}$ at $27^\circ\text{C}$. Determine the static and dynamic resistance. Also calculate the reverse saturation current when temperature rises to $47^\circ\text{C}$.
With a neat diagram, explain the structure and operation of MOSFET. Also, sketch and explain the $I_D$-$V_{GS}$ and $I_D$-$V_{DS}$ characteristics.
With the help of an appropriate circuit, input & output waveforms, explain the working of a full wave center-tap rectifier with capacitor filter.

A full wave Bridge rectifier circuit is fed by ac mains of rms 230 V, 50 Hz supply through a transformer having turns ratio of 10:1. If the load resistance is $1\text{k}\Omega$, assuming the diode resistance to be zero, determine

(i) Average output voltage.
(ii) Average load current.
(iii) Output DC power.

In a voltage regulator using Zener diode, the output voltage $V_0 = 5\text{ V}$, Input voltage $V_i = (12\pm 3)\text{ V}$, $R_S = 1\text{k}\Omega$, Load current $I_L = 20\text{ mA}$. Find the minimum and maximum currents flowing through the Zener diode.
Explain with a neat circuit diagram how op-amp works as differentiator and derive the expression for output voltage.

Derive the expression for the output voltage of a non-inverting op-amp amplifier with a neat circuit diagram. Find the output voltage for input $V_{in} = 2\sin(2\pi100t)$. Given $\pm V_{cc} = 15\text{ V}$, $R_F = 10\text{k}\Omega$ and $R_1 = 2\text{k}\Omega$. Plot both input and output waveforms indicating all features in it.

questions.markdown: A hexadecimal numbers B(16) is transmitted using a (7,4) Hamming code with even parity. During transmission, an error occurs in the 3rd bit of the codeword. Analyse and determine what is the received codeword, showing all steps of reasoning.

A logic circuit compares 2 inputs (A and B). It produces 3 outputs G, L and E, where G is high when $A>B$, L is high when $A<B$ and E is high when $A=B$. Design the circuit with the help of a truth table and a circuit diagram using basic gates.

Using KMAP, Deduce the simplified Boolean expression and implement it using only NAND gates for the following expression.

$$
F = \sum_m (0,2,5,7,8,13) + d(10,15)
$$

Given an FM equation $V_{FM}(t)=10\cos[2\pi 10^8 t + 5\sin(2\pi 15000 t)]$, Calculate Carrier frequency. Modulating frequency. Frequency deviation. Bandwidth using Carson's rule.
Apply your understanding of communication systems to explain its components using a labeled block diagram.
Given Binary information 10110101 plot ASK, FSK and PSK wave forms.
